scope: КИБЕР ПОРТАЛ shared «Подборки» block across homepage, articles, compilation pages, /compilations/ index, and robot-card exclusion.
claim: Current implementation and contract for the «Подборки» block is approved as the project-wide rule to follow going forward.
rules: Reusable «Подборки» block uses exactly 5 cards: 4 topical canonical compilation cards + final «Все наши подборки».
Homepage keeps approved placement after Gosha quote; normal content pages place the block last before footer.
Robot-card pages do not use the shared «Подборки» block.
/compilations/ is the visual exception: it lists all ready/planned compilation cards and uses the page-specific larger card style.
All reused cards must be canonical cards from /compilations/: same title, description, image, href and ready/planned status.
Do not invent page-local compilation names/descriptions. If no close match exists, reuse one of the ready canonical cards.
Run npm run test:compilation-blocks before readiness/publication handoff.
